items.evidence_quote: (2) Neuromyelitis optica spectrum disorder (NMOSD)... however, the brainstem speech episode and heat sensitivity are more typical of MS.

items.evidence_quote: Serum aquaporin-4 and MOG antibodies: to exclude NMOSD and MOGAD.
items.reason: Investigations are prioritised, each with an explicit purpose, and directly linked to the differential hypotheses.

linked_observations.observation: Section 4 fulfils the 'missing information' half of the instruction but omits the requested explicit questions, a single deviation affecting both instruction following and completeness.

d5c.evidence_quote: Have you had any previous similar episodes of unsteadiness, vision loss, numbness, weakness, or bladder problems, and are there any existing MRI reports of the brain or spinal cord?
d5c.reason: All three essential requirements were actively and appropriately requested before the final assessment: onset/course and aggravating factors (turns 1–2), prior neurological episodes (turn 4), and existing examination/imaging/CSF confirmation routes (turns 3, 5, 6). Requests were targeted, well prioritised, and unavailability of records is a simulator limitation, not an acquisition failure.
